title: Blog Title Generator
description: Generate 24 click-worthy blog titles from your keyword — listicles, how-tos, questions and guides from real templates.
howto: Enter your main keyword or topic.
Pick a tone: professional, casual, bold or curious.
Browse 24 generated titles and copy any of them with one click.

faqs.a: Your keyword is slotted into 24 proven title templates — listicles, how-tos, questions, mistakes-to-avoid and ultimate guides — then adjusted for the tone you picked.

faqs.q: Can I use these for YouTube videos too?
faqs.a: Yes. The templates work for video titles, podcast episodes and newsletter subjects as well as blog posts.

faqs.q: Will two people get the same titles?
faqs.a: Anyone using the same keyword gets the same template set — always rewrite the winner in your own voice before publishing.
